title: Filipino-Style Noodle Stir Fry
description: A quick and flavorful stir fry made with noodles, soybean sprouts, and a hint of Filipino flavor.
instructions: Cook noodles according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add garlic, onion, and green chili. Cook until the onion is translucent.
Add soybean sprouts and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Stir in soy sauce and oyster sauce. Cook for an additional minute.
Add cooked noodles to the skillet and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the noodles are well coated with the sauce.
